question: How do I create an account?
answer: Open the sign-up page, enter your name, work email, and a password, then verify the email we send you. After verification you can log in and start using the product.

question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
answer: On the login page click Forgot password, enter your email, and follow the reset link. The link expires in 30 minutes. If you do not see the email, check spam.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and UPI. Invoices can also be paid by bank transfer on the Business plan.

question: How do I update my billing details?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing, click Edit payment method, and save the new card or UPI details. Future invoices will use the updated method.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: Monthly plans can be refunded within 7 days of the charge if usage is under 10%. Annual plans are prorated after the first 14 days. Contact billing with your invoice number.

question: What is included in the Free plan?
answer: The Free plan includes 1 workspace, 3 team members, and 50 support tickets per month. FAQ search and basic reports are included.

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: Open Settings > Plans, choose the new plan, and confirm. Upgrades start immediately. Downgrades take effect at the next billing date.

question: How do I add teammates?
answer: Go to Settings > Team, click Invite, and enter their email. They receive a link to join your workspace. Admins can change roles later.

question: Do you have an API?
answer: Yes. Business and Enterprise plans include a REST API. Create an API key under Settings > Developers. Rate limit is 120 requests per minute.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Chat and email support run Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST. Enterprise customers get 24/7 phone support.

question: How do I talk to a human agent?
answer: Ask to be connected to a person in this chat, or email support@example.com. A teammate will pick up escalated tickets from the dashboard.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes. Data in transit uses TLS 1.2+. Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. We do not train public models on your tickets.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping is 5 to 7 business days in India. Express shipping is 1 to 2 business days. You will get a tracking link by email.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Unused items can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Start a return from Orders > Request return. Refunds appear in 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item.
